sources.snippet: A new tutorial from Marktechpost walks through a complete supervised fine-tuning (SFT) pipeline that teaches Qwen3-0.6B, a compact open-weight language model, to make structured tool calls. The pipeline uses the XYZ-Aquila-SFT dataset, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT (Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning), and PyTorch.
